api_calls: bounded canonical ONVIF GetStreamUri plus internal FFmpeg probe for profile_1 and profile_2

hypothesis: A indisponibilidade do caminho compartilhado e do ingest local pode ser separada da disponibilidade da origem RTSP configurada por probes internos do Toposync.
outcome: Before remediation, configured relay origins rejected authentication while canonical ONVIF profile URIs probed successfully. The atomic ONVIF-profile rebind was then applied and read back; configured-origin probes and decoder-fresh snapshots now succeed for profile_1 and profile_2.
acquisition_decision: Use the shared decoder as the normal observer. In the post-rebind window it needed 1.98 seconds for the first frame and then supplied ten distinct decoder frames at 249 to 350 millisecond request-completion intervals. Keep direct configured-origin probing as a diagnostic fallback, not as a continuous second connection.

remediation_preflight.change: Bind exact ONVIF profiles with their canonical URI and inherited ONVIF credentials.
remediation_preflight.apply_contract: One atomic extension patch, mandatory readback, automatic restoration of the previous devices list when readback differs.
